method: Second intensive review of the supplied bytes. Static analysis only: atomscan, cleave facts, UPX decompression, rizin xrefs/control flow and Capstone disassembly. No specimen, command, host export or network endpoint was executed. Reputation and collector filenames were not used as behavioral proof.

samples.identification: UPX-packed Gh0st-lineage native Server.dll RAT with Hidden/QAssist drivers
evidence: The 347136-byte PE decompresses to 1310720 bytes. Its native export Main at VA 0x1001bdf0 constructs Loader on the stack, resolves a host-supplied configuration function, applies the cyclic word-key XOR routine at 0x100153b0 to the returned configuration, copies configuration fields, and calls startup 0x1001a700. Missing host configuration causes an early return; successful standalone startup is not claimed.

Socket connector 0x10004300 creates a TCP socket, resolves its destination, constructs the sockaddr and calls connect at 0x100043b1. Receiver 0x10004200 selects and receives into its buffer at 0x10004292, passes the received bytes to 0x100045a0, and the framed/decompression path calls the manager virtual handler at 0x100047a9. The code contains remote shell, file and system management handlers.

Polling loop 0x1000a744 sleeps 10 ms, queries Shift/CapsLock and GetAsyncKeyState at 0x1000a7a7, tests AH bit 7, tracks key transitions and appends key labels to a buffer. Enter appends the <Enter> CRLF record and calls recorder 0x1000a480. Foreground-window routine 0x1000a5d0 records window titles through the same writer.

Recorder 0x1000a480 builds a .key path under the system directory with a configuration-selected stem, opens it, seeks to its end below the cap, XORs every record byte with 0x62 at 0x1000a590, and passes the resulting buffer, record length and file handle to WriteFile at 0x1000a5aa. This is recording, not ordinary hotkey handling.

Shell-manager command branch at 0x1001cd60 checks opcode 5, writes attacker-provided bytes to a GetMP.exe path under the system directory, and at 0x1001ce20 copies GetMP privilege::debug sekurlsa::logonpasswords exit CRLF into the pipe-write request. The nearby shell setup builds redirected stdin/stdout pipes and calls its resolved CreateProcess pointer at 0x1001c3b0. Availability or successful execution of the remotely supplied dumper is not assumed.

Destructive routine 0x1000c180 opens PhysicalDrive0 for read/write at 0x1000c1e2. It prepares an otherwise cleared 512-byte sector with 55 AA and an optional short bootstrap, locks the volume, writes that buffer at offset zero at 0x1000c229, unlocks/closes it, enables shutdown privilege and requests forced reboot at 0x1000c278. Dispatcher 0x1000c290 calls this routine at 0x1000c2bb.

Driver staging at 0x10015b50 chooses the 32/64-bit embedded image by IsWow64Process and writes the selected bytes through WriteFile at 0x10015b76. The explicit payload lengths are 0xf648 and 0x13048; carving heuristics can include following parent data.

In the x86 QAssist driver, directory-filter routine 0x004033b0 tests the returned name against its hidden-file/directory sets, removes matches by updating NextEntryOffset or copying later entries forward, and zeroes removed data. The removal log is referenced at 0x00403516. Thus the hiding strings correspond to an implemented minifilter path.
samples.limits: Static implemented capabilities and command paths are established. No live C2 session, successful driver load, dump, exfiltration or reboot was observed. The exact subfamily attribution beyond Gh0st lineage is left open.
false_positives: The former logical-drive-copy-worm rule could pass entirely on drive enumeration, directory APIs and unrelated file/process APIs, with no copy or replication evidence. Those capabilities remain notable under fs/enumerate/drives.
The former SFX executable-member rule treated binary-delimited .exe text as an archive member. It is retired; its consumer now requires the existing parsed executable-member fact.

The CArchive-like EXE record pattern collided with antivirus executable names in trailing parent data inside a carved child. The overlay observation now additionally requires the CArchive cookie and has its canonical home in binary/layout/overlay.

evidence: Read every byte of the HTML and the cleave facts. There is no encoded layer, external script, credential field, form, submission handler, network-send API or credential source/sink.

The sole executable code is a button onclick assignment: location.href=login.php. On a click this navigates to a relative path. No login.php contents or server behavior are supplied. The title, adult-age wording and local login route do not prove deceptive credential capture.
samples.changes: Retire the three unsupported phishing/lure judgments. Preserve the accurate notable invite wording, adult-age text and local-navigation observations.
samples.limits: This judgment applies to the supplied HTML, not an unprovided destination page or hosting service.

reference_audit: The Elex identity consumer now explicitly references the neutral drive/file API profile. Its independent Elex marker and batch requirements are preserved.
The SFX member consumer uses parsed archive-member metadata with outer scope and explicit PE/archive types. A generic executable-name byte sequence supplies no staging or archive-member claim.

The direction-neutral cyclic word-key byte XOR loop moves unchanged from data/decode/xor to data/encoding/xor. Its explicit loader consumer is updated and no longer claims a decoding direction or T1140 from that loop alone.
The CArchive overlay consumers are updated to the relocated cookie-gated observation. The incomplete TOC fragment is a component because it does not establish the archive format by itself.

The only broad fs/enumerate/drives selector found in a positive consumer is a Python-scoped ransomware enrichment rule; the new PE-scoped capability does not broaden it. No alias retains retired objective identities.

verification.controls: 13 static controls passed: renamed DLL, another nonzero XOR key, zero key, different output buffer, absent polling import, absent key label, both compiler pressed-bit/decrement forms, ordinary drive-management imports, EXE-shaped overlay without cookie, cookie-correlated overlay, invite page, ordinary local-login page.
verification.artifacts: Only the generator and review are stored in this repository. Decompressed images, facts, disassembly, JSON reports and generated PE controls remain in the named scratch directory.
verification.rescans: Both original paths rescanned with atomscan --no-update --mode slow --follow=none and an absolute CLEAVE_TRAITS_DIR. DLL retains all four required hostile traits; unsupported worm, SFX member and CArchive findings are absent. HTML has five notable findings and no suspicious or hostile findings.
verification.fixture_correction: Validation exposed a byte-identical hostile HTML fixture. Moved it to benign/whatsapp-invite-local-login.html and replaced the three required attack findings with five required neutral UI findings, max_hostile=0 and max_suspicious=0. The separate ordinary WhatsApp join-link control remains benign.
